'''greatrambino1981 My First Light Side Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[greatrambino1981]]
* '''Published:''' 2 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' My First Light Side Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat My First Light Side Deck greatrambi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I have been collecting since Premier and never found anyone to play with. I finally learned how to play and this is my first attempt at deck building. Any feedback would be greatlty appreciated.

== Strategy ==

Use Squadron Assignments to pull matching pilots/ships. The other characters are to secure ground sites. I know an objective would help, but I don't know which one.
